effects.effect: When you take the [Disengage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.move-actions/disengage) move action, one ally in the area of your [Null Field](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-field) ability can also take the [Disengage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.move-actions/disengage) move action as a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action), using your [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) for that move action.
